projects.project_title: Anatolia Green Electric-Arc Steel & 120 MW Solar + BESS Decarbonization Project
projects.project_summary: Retrofitting a major Turkish steel rolling facility to 100% renewable-powered electric-arc furnace operation paired with 120 MW captive solar PV and 60 MWh lithium-iron-phosphate battery storage to achieve EU CBAM compliance. Contact finance@anatoliacleanmetal.example.tr for technical annex.
projects.climate_rationale: Cuts steelmaking Scope 1 and Scope 2 carbon intensity by 62% (185,000 tCO2e/year avoided), directly supporting Türkiye's 2035 NDC and TIDIP industrial decarbonization targets.
projects.technology_and_innovation: High-efficiency scrap preheating electric-arc furnace integrated with grid-forming 60 MWh BESS, digital twin energy dispatch, and ISO 14064 real-time carbon MRV.
projects.esg_and_social_impact: Creates 320 green engineering jobs, zero coal usage, closed-loop 85% process water recycling, and formal workforce reskilling aligned with Just Transition principles.
projects.key_risks_and_mitigants: Grid curtailment risk mitigated via 60 MWh BESS; FX mismatch mitigated by EUR-denominated EU green-steel export offtake contracts covering 75% of output; EPC turnkey fixed-price contract.

projects.project_title: Antalya Solar-Powered Precision Drip Irrigation & Climate-Resilient Cold Chain
projects.project_summary: Women-led Mediterranean agricultural SME deploying IoT soil-moisture precision drip irrigation across 1,800 hectares in Antalya alongside 2.5 MW agrivoltaic rooftop solar and low-GWP cold storage to cut water consumption by 48%.
projects.climate_rationale: Addresses severe Mediterranean drought and extreme heat risks by reducing groundwater extraction by 4.1 million m3/year while replacing diesel irrigation pumps with solar PV (4,200 tCO2e/year avoided).
projects.technology_and_innovation: LoRaWAN soil-moisture & evapotranspiration sensors automated with solar pumping and natural-refrigerant cold chain extending export shelf life by 40%.
projects.esg_and_social_impact: Women-owned enterprise employing 68% female agricultural technicians; directly strengthens climate resilience for 14,500 rural residents and 420 smallholder farms.
projects.key_risks_and_mitigants: Weather yield variability mitigated by parametric agricultural insurance (TARSİM); credit collateral backed by KGF Green Transformation Guarantee and confirmed EU organic supermarket buyer contracts.

projects.project_title: Afro-Med Distributed Grid Storage & Clean Electrification Virtual Power Plant
projects.project_summary: Deploying 90 MWh of modular utility-connected battery energy storage and AI virtual power plant dispatch across industrial parks in Egypt to displace peaking diesel/gas generation and stabilize solar grid integration.
projects.climate_rationale: Enables 140 MW of additional solar absorption without curtailment and displaces 92,000 tCO2e/year of peaking fossil generation, directly advancing the COP31 35-by-35 Global Electrification Pledge.
projects.technology_and_innovation: Modular containerized LFP storage orchestrated by machine-learning grid frequency forecasting and automated demand-response telemetry.
projects.esg_and_social_impact: Eliminates blackouts for 85,000 industrial/community power users, reduces urban diesel particulate emissions, and trains 150 local grid engineers.
projects.key_risks_and_mitigants: Currency convertibility and utility offtake risk mitigated via DFI partial risk guarantee (10by30 / CIF AMPLIFi catalytic tranche) and USD-indexed industrial park power capacity contracts.
